text:
For elastic scattering, the partial-wave amplitude in the forward direction is

\[
f(0)=\frac{1}{k}\sum_{\ell}(2\ell+1)e^{i\delta_\ell}\sin\delta_\ell,
\]

so

\[
\operatorname{Im}f(0)=\frac{1}{k}\sum_{\ell}(2\ell+1)\sin^2\delta_\ell.
\]

Using \(K=50\ \text{MeV}\),

\[
k=\frac{\sqrt{2m_ec^2K}}{\hbar c}
=\frac{\sqrt{2(0.511)(50)}}{197.327}
\approx 0.03623\ \text{fm}^{-1}.
\]

The phase-shift sum is

\[
\begin{aligned}
S&=\sin^2 90^\circ+3\sin^2 67^\circ+5\sin^2 55^\circ
 +7\sin^2 30^\circ+9\sin^2 13^\circ\\
&\approx 9.1025.
\end{aligned}
\]

Therefore,

\[
\operatorname{Im}f(0)=\frac{9.1025}{0.03623}
\approx 251.27\ \text{fm}.
\]

Answer: A
